text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mock Race Spectator Student
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What a front-running sprint is 
that!? Could that girl be the one from the 
rumors recently...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since watching Haiseiko's concert, 
Smart Falcon has steadily grown both in 
ability and popularity. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Falco's been thinking, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So next time, I'd like to do a solo Falco 
live concert!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Watching Haiseiko's live performance made 
me realize that every Umamusume needs to 
hone her own individuality.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Since then, Falco worked hard to shine in 
her own way too☆, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking that I'd love to know 
clearly how many people are captivated by 
Falco's sparkle right now~."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Will you help me out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so. Squeezing it in between training 
sessions, we decided to proceed with 
preparations for the concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let me see. For this part of the 
choreography, we could arrange it by 
making 'L' shapes with both hands—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Alrighty, gotta post our trial-and-error 
process on UmaStagram too for some promo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Kyururunâ Aiming to be the top Umadol, 
it's Falco giving her all on the dirt 
trackâ Everyone, please come to my next 
live show~â
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And the result was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was a small box, but even so, it was 
never completely filled.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—All right! All right! All right! Thanks 
for waiting, everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who watched the race, everyone 
who found out from the online 
announcement, and everyone who came after 
seeing the flyers! A huge thank-you to all 
of you☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ Make sure you enjoy plenty of 
lovely Falco today! Alright then, let's 
get the music started☆

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. The venue was small, but it 
wasn't a bad concert at all!"

text_block_list.name: Whimsical Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon, huh... She might be someone 
to keep an eye on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, that was so much fun! I hope you 
had fun too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank goodness! I'd be totally 
crushed if my Number One Fan wasn't happy 
with it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I know things won't just immediately go 
as smoothly as they did for Haiseiko-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, for all the fans watching right 
now, I'm gonna give them everything 
Falco's got!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, Falco's radiance will 
spread farther and wider—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —And someday, I will!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is our starting line! Right, 
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...This is Smart Falcon's strength. It 
made me realize once again that I want to 
support her as a Trainer, as a manager, 
and as a fan."
